object: one page of a script: each scene is a piece of my work, my line reads in English or Korean, and the pencil note in the margin is the proof with the case behind it
desc: A short path through Allen Kang's work: research with real people, rough ideas taken to shipped products, and the tools a bilingual musical company ran on.
lede: I’m Allen, a product designer in Toronto, glad to work Pacific hours. Eight years designing, from interviews and journey maps to prototypes and release. A forty-person amateur musical ran for ten months on tools I built: the schedule, a script reader in Korean and English, and the shared costs. I prototype in code with Claude Code and Cursor.
caption: Pick a scene, then switch the language. The note in the margin opens the case.
h1: I design tools for people making something together.
contact: I’d like to help writers and studios spend less time chasing versions and more time on the story.
